turns.customer: I've used the Glowworm headlamp from order #1050 on a few night hikes, and now it won't turn on, even with new batteries. Can I return it?
turns.reply: I’m sorry the Glowworm headlamp stopped working. Because the issue occurred after use, it isn’t eligible for a return under our policy. However, a manufacturing defect may be covered by the 1‑year warranty, and a team member will review your case. A support ticket (ESC-33) has been created, and you’ll receive an email follow‑up within one business day. Thanks for your understanding.
